releaseTitle: SOREX / Swarix v3.0 – Liquid Glass Navbar, Mini Player Skip Controls & Dolby Atmos DSP
changelog:
1. Liquid Glass Bottom Navigation Bar with specular light refraction and frosted translucency
2. Mini Player Previous Track Control Button (⏮ / Skip Previous) alongside Play/Pause and Next
3. Dynamic In-App Version Tracking in Settings & About dialog
4. Dolby Atmos 3D Spatial & Concert Hall Live Arena DSP Modes in Equalizer & Soundstage
5. Advanced Hybrid AI Music Recommendation Engine (Content-Based + Collaborative + User Taste Profile + Session Context)
6. Strict Language & Mood Consistency guards (Hindi Romantic -> Hindi Romantic, never abruptly jumping to clashing genres)
7. Fixed Listening History & Search Separation: typing/displaying search results never creates history records; only actual playback records ID, duration, completion %, and skip status
8. Multilingual Devanagari/Hindi Lyrics Search and Typo-Tolerant Search
